message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (per 9‑x‑13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or a mix of beef & pork | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot or celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 bay leaf, ½ cup carrot/celery |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (950 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| **Parmesan** | Grated Parmesan (top layer) | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach, mushrooms, zucchini, or roasted red peppers | 1–2 cups, sautéed or raw |
| | Pesto or fresh basil leaves for garnish | as desired |

### Quick Prep Tips
1. **Cook the noodles** until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment to prevent sticking.
2. **Brown the meat** with onions and garlic; add tomatoes, seasonings, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Mix ricotta** with egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Make bechamel** by whisking butter and flour, then slowly adding milk while whisking until thickened.
5. **Layer**: Start with a thin sauce base, then noodles, meat sauce, ricotta, bechamel, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
